summary_up_top.suggest: Move navigational metadata and audio/accessibility player elements out of the main reading flow so readers immediately see the core argument.

edits.why: Navigation, breadcrumbs, date, and text-to-speech widgets interrupt the mobile reading flow before the lede.
edits.how: Move all metadata, breadcrumbs, 'Skip to article content', font-size toggles, and the audio player to a sticky header or above the H1 title.

edits.how: Break para 9 into three smaller paragraphs around the tower counts and the energy consumption data.

edits.how: Split para 12 into three distinct paragraphs based on the chronological shifts in the argument.
